notes: fix-79 completed: DiplomacyAI design doc compliance. Refactored applyProposeTreaty to use proper treaties.ts flow (proposeTreaty/acceptTreaty) instead of directly creating active treaties. Added TODO for AI acceptance formula implementation per relationship-formulas.md §9.1.

worker_output.summary: Reviewed diplomacyAI.ts for design compliance. Found and fixed one issue: applyProposeTreaty was creating treaties directly with isActive=true, bypassing the proper propose/accept flow from treaties.ts. Now uses proposeTreaty() to create pending treaties, then acceptTreaty() for AI-to-AI treaties (auto-accept), while AI-to-player treaties remain pending for UI acceptance. Added test fixture fix for missing incomingProposals field. Verified existing honorable/peaceful trait handling correctly implements design doc rules for war declaration.
